AdapterKind.description:
Engine adapter that speaks to a tool. A new kind of tool needs an adapter; a new tool of
an existing kind needs only a registry entry.

oneOf.description: CodeGraph CLI over the code root's live index (`query`, `callers`, `impact`).

Any `kb.code.v1` provider (ADR 0011), e.g. `kb-code-provider --backend ast-index`.
Commit-bound: answers describe the code root's `HEAD` commit.
Built-in `git grep` over tracked and untracked files; lexical symbol fallback.
A configured check command (argv, no shell).

SyncMode.description: When the codegraph adapter brings the live index up to date.

oneOf.description: Run the tool's incremental sync before every query.
Query the index as it is; the answer reports pending changes.

args.description: Extra arguments placed before the adapter's own (`code-provider` only).

description.description: `command` only: one-line purpose shown by `kb tools` and `kb check`.

paths.description: `command` only: globs (optionally `repo:`-qualified) of files that trigger the check.

program.description:
Program: a bare name is looked up on PATH; `{kb}/...` is relative to the KB root,
`{host}/...` and other relative paths to the code root. Not used by `git-grep`.

run.description:
`command` only: argv after `program`; the whole argument `{files}` expands to the
matched files, `{kb}`/`{host}` prefixes expand to the KB and code roots.

description: Connected code tools, their adapters and the route of each request; command tools are the checks `kb check` runs.

routes.description:
Ordered fallback per capability; an omitted capability uses the default order of the
declared tools that support it.

tool.description: Connected tools, in declaration order (the order `kb check` runs commands in).

title: Tool registry (<profile>/tools.toml)
